objective: Decision 0104: SHANNON's 17 ForgeGUI Shadow Legion models (heavy knight to shieldbearer commander), each cut from its sheet and skinned to the Stations rig, uploaded for the new Hexbound roster.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of the 17 models is one mesh with no base, sign, title or second copy from its sheet
Standing ones walk, attack and fall with the biped clips; the dragons flap their wings; the mounted ones move as four-legged

No part stretches: every face follows one bone (the skin is cut apart where two bones' parts meet), and `skin_forge.py --stretch` finds no face stretched by a quarter in any of the game's strongest poses
Each is uploaded and in StationAssets
verification: skin_forge.py --stretch per model (0% stretched in every pose, and its bones view checked by eye); Studio, local build, stamp `dev`: each spawned from the admin Enemies tab.
notes: SHANNON, 2026-11-20: "begin rigging for everything from the heavy knight onwards", then "there should be 17 models now, rig them all please". Models 01:27 to 02:01; the 01:26 Shadow Knight sheet is not used (the knight is in, STATION-112). SHANNON, 2026-11-20: "many of the models have warping parts", then "go for method one now" (fix the rigs, no new models). The first rigs blended each vertex between bones by rough regions, and ForgeGUI grows arms, capes and weapons onto the body, so parts smeared (up to 36% of a model's surface stretched by a quarter in its power move) and some were on the wrong bone (the Shieldbearer's whole body on its shield arm, the Ogre's club on its head, capes on an arm or a leg). Now each model's joints and parts are placed by hand (`legion`, boxes read off the --stretch bones view) and the skin is cut apart at the joints: 0% stretched in every pose for all 18. SHANNON, 2026-11-21: regenerate in ForgeGUI so they rig well, the Ogre Enforcer, Shadow Archer and Necromancer first ("dont use the forgegui rigging"). Given pictures, ForgeGUI kept their poses (its A-pose setting did nothing), so they are cleaner but rigged the same way, cut at the joints (skin_forge `legion`: base colour texture picked, thinned to 8,000 triangles, flat shaded); in the game for SHANNON to compare before the other enemies. SHANNON: the Shadow Archer in a true A-pose with its bow made apart ("the walk animation looks weird in this pose"), then its animations redone: ForgeGUI made it from a description in an A-pose (standard quality, 5,100 triangles), the bow on its own; joined with the bow low in its left hand (6,300 triangles), skinned with blended shoulders and its arms lowered to rest by its sides (skin_forge `rest`). Its power move is now its own volley (MAGICS in Creatures.client): the shared one turned the bow over behind its head. SHANNON: a proper attack for the Shadow Archer, pulling back the bow: its own clip (ATTACKS in Creatures.client), turning side-on, drawing to its cheek and loosing at the contact; the Crossbow Troop keeps the shared one. Its boots no longer stretch (the legs take the whole boot below the cloak). The Shadow Knight signed off by SHANNON ("the knight is great"). The Archer's shot reworked ("adjust the position of the bow when the archer is shooting"): it squares up with the bow held straight at the target instead of turning side-on, which left the bow beside its chest. The Heavy Knight next: ForgeGUI made it in an A-pose and its hammer and shield as one model, the hammer held ahead in its right hand and the shield on its left arm (6,700 triangles). SHANNON: two enemies at a time from here, every weapon of the pair in one generation, shown before the next pair. The Battle Priest and Shieldbearer: ForgeGUI made each in an A-pose and their four props (staff, book, tower shield, sword) in one model, split by where each stands; rigged by hand ("dont get forge to rig these two"). The Shieldbearer's legs start below its plated skirt, which stays with the body. Also, as a one-off comparison SHANNON asked for, ForgeGUI rigged the Heavy Knight's body (job 1220c2e3) and animated it (idle, walk, slash, hurt, fall); not used in the game. SHANNON chose the game's own moves over ForgeGUI's ("we're gonna go with your animations"), asked for a bigger hammer (now about a third longer, head tipped down) and for attack and power concepts for the Heavy Knight, made in Blender on the game's rig and timing, to pick from. SHANNON picked the Overhead Crush and the Leaping Slam for the Heavy Knight, with the hammer pointing at the ground on the hit: its own clips (ATTACKS, MAGICS in Creatures.client), the arm straight down and twisted 20 degrees at contact so the head drives into the ground ahead. The Battle Priest holds its staff and book in its fists (combine grips), the book bigger; the Shieldbearer's shield is huge (shoulder to ankle) and its sword a third longer. Held props follow their hand whole (skin_forge `held`: by where their texture sits in the atlas). SHANNON picked the effects: the Heavy Knight's attack lands a small shockwave (flash, ring, cracks), its Leaping Slam a big shockwave with the Shadow Eruption (the hammer charges with light, crystal spikes burst up round the impact); a purple trail follows the hammer in both (WEAPON_FX in Creatures.client, between "tip" and "neck" bones in the hammer's head: skin_forge `tips`). Idle concepts made for the five remade enemies, to pick from. SHANNON: idle poses rather than loops, and the Priest still not holding its staff or book ("holding his staff outward and on the ground with the book half open"). ForgeGUI remade the Priest with closed fists, and a half-open book and an arrow in one model; the staff and book are set in its fists for its idle pose (the staff upright on the ground with the arm out, the book at its chest). The Shadow Archer holds an arrow, set for a nocked pose; its shot and volley draw with the same arm so the arrow points at the target, then at the sky. Two idle poses per remade enemy made to pick from (not in the game yet). SHANNON: the Priest's book too big and "all the poses look very unnatural". The arms only turned at the shoulder: the five A-pose rigs gain elbow bones (elbow_l, elbow_r; decision 0104), the idle poses are redone with bent arms (to pick from), the Priest's arms rest bent (staff upright in its fist, a smaller open book before its chest) and the Archer draws side-on along its chest, its arrow in line with its forearm. Bones hanging from a lowered arm (the hammer's tip and neck) now sit where the rest pose took them, and the attack's shockwave is the small one of the concept. SHANNON picked idle poses: Shadow Knight and Shadow Archer "at ease", Heavy Knight "hammer grounded", Battle Priest "reading" (STANCES in Creatures.client; none picked for the Shieldbearer yet), and asked for the arrow out of the Archer's hand at ease: it rests in the quiver on its own bone (skin_forge `stowed`) and the shot and volley bring it to the string. Attack concepts out of each idle pose made to pick from.
